interpret_filters_filterinterpreter: interpret a FILTERS logical form dict into a chain of MemoryFilter objects using FilterInterpreter
interpret_where_clause: interpret a nested where clause dict with AND, OR, NOT conjunctions into MemoryFilter objects
interpret_selector: interpret a selector dict to build location-based, random, or extreme value memory selectors
interpret_task_filter: interpret task-specific filter dictionaries and convert special task tags like currently_running or paused into comparators
convert_task_where: convert special task tags in a where clause dict into comparator-based where clauses for task filtering
